newsitem.title: USA: Winstar gets okay to enter Colo. market.
newsitem.headline: Winstar gets okay to enter Colo. market.

text.p: WinStar Communications Inc said on Monday it received authorization from Colorado to provide competitive local exchange carrier services there.
The certification allows WinStar to provide an array of local voice, videa and data services in competition with the incumbent local exchange company in Colorado, Winstar said.
WinStar said it already had similar authorization in California, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Massachusetts, Michigan, New York, Tennessee, Texas, Washington and Wisconsin.
The company plans to provide competitive local exchange carrier services in Colorado in 1997. It said it had 38 GHz licenses in Denver.
